name: Ragi Mudde
steps: Mix 30 g of the ragi flour with 100 ml cool water to make a smooth slurry.
Bring remaining water and salt to a boil in a heavy deep saucepan. Stir in the slurry and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add remaining ragi flour in an even mound and cook on low heat for 3 minutes before mixing.
Stir firmly with a sturdy wooden spoon, breaking all lumps, then cover and steam on low heat for 8–10 minutes until the mixture is glossy and fully cooked.
Cool just enough to handle safely. Divide into four portions and shape into smooth balls with wet hands or two wet bowls; brush with ghee.
Serve hot with a separately prepared dal or sambar. The dough should be soft and cohesive, with no dry flour pockets.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
